_README: Hand-curated input to generate-redirects.mjs for the odelco tenant.
Everything here is a HUMAN JUDGEMENT the Geins API cannot supply: the old
VirtueMart taxonomy was reorganised during migration, so old and new slugs
do not correspond by any string rule (7% auto-match — see PROPOSAL.md).
category: old VirtueMart path -> Geins category ALIAS. Each row also becomes
an ancestor-fallback for every descendant of that path, which is
how ~32 curated rows cover 217 crawled category paths.
brand:    old /varumarken/<slug> -> Geins brand ALIAS (only where they differ;
cms:      old path -> Geins CMS page ALIAS.
exact:    old path -> full new path, verbatim. Used for the VirtueMart
UNREVIEWED ROWS ARE MARKED _review. A merchant must confirm these before
this map goes live; several are 'closest surviving parent', not equivalents.
